intake.dialogue.opening: I’m the AI assistant. The doctor reviews your answers during your visit; this does not replace it or provide medical advice. What brings you to this appointment?
intake.dialogue.additional: Is there anything else you want to add or correct for your visit?
intake.dialogue.incomplete: We can stop the interview here. Anything still unclear needs review with the doctor during your visit.
intake.dialogue.unavailable: We couldn’t respond just now. Try again in a moment, or keep your appointment: the doctor can see you without this step.
intake.dialogue.urgent_qr: Alert hospital staff now or knock on the consultation room door so they can assess you.
intake.dialogue.urgent_home: Seek urgent in-person care at an emergency department now or call {number}. Do not wait for your appointment.
intake.dialogue.case_opening: I’m the AI assistant: I’ll ask you a couple of questions so the hospital team understands your case. It gives no medical advice. What do you need? [opciones: I have results to show the doctor | I need a check-up or a prescription | I have a new symptom]
intake.dialogue.case_done: Done, that’s enough. Send the request and the hospital team will review it.
_comment: Pre-consult interview chat, age.mjs and platform/photo-zoom.mjs. intake.nav.entrevistas is the admin panel's sidebar label (admin_sections, Tier 2 pilot 2026-08-05) — it used to live in locales/en/admin.shell.json because the sidebar item was an admin.html literal <a>.
intake.entrevista.title: Tell your doctor how you're feeling
intake.entrevista.subtitle_qr: Tell us what's going on while you wait. Your doctor reads it during the visit: this doesn't replace it or give medical advice.
intake.entrevista.subtitle_default: Your doctor will read your answers during the visit: this doesn't replace it or give medical advice.
intake.entrevista.attach_title: Attach a photo (for example, of a skin area or a test result)
intake.entrevista.done_qr: Done — your doctor will read your answers during the visit.
intake.entrevista.done_default: Done — thanks for telling us. Your doctor will read your answers during the visit.
intake.entrevista.load_error_lede: Try again in a moment — your appointment isn't lost because of this.
intake.entrevista.rate_limited: You sent several messages in a row. Wait a bit and write again.
intake.entrevista.attachment_invalid: That photo couldn't be used — try another image, a smaller one.
intake.entrevista.answer_error: We had a problem answering you. Try again.
intake.entrevista.id_lede: If you already have an account, log in so you don't have to type anything else.
